# nonValidSlideId

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is **not** a slide id.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonValidSlideId() — Checks whether a value is **not** a slide id. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonValidSlideId(value: unknown): boolean;
```

`nonValidSlideId(value)` is the same test as `!isValidSlideId(value)`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence rather than as a negation.

Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at least one of them. Slide ids are short — `p1` is a perfectly ordinary one — so no minimum length is imposed.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is not a slide id; otherwise `false`.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
nonValidSlideId("has space"); // => true
nonValidSlideId(""); // => true
nonValidSlideId("p1"); // => false
nonValidSlideId("SLIDES_api123"); // => false
```
